experiments.title: Bounded streaming of GEMM partial planes
experiments.implemented_scope: Shipped GEMM dispatcher uses sixteen exact leaf planes plus twelve carry planes when all leaf planes would exceed that live storage. CNN device_gemm now consults the same reach predicate before its forced TN/Apple plans, so eligible public convolution/linear gradients reach streaming with correctly sized scratch.

experiments.title: Cache convolution weight layouts by generation
experiments.source_disposition: rejected_for_incumbent_no_repack; helper parked for a separately justified packed-layout consumer
experiments.implemented_scope: Source-level rejection of the proposed incumbent repack-cache optimization: _conv_relu_on_device passes the existing OC-by-K dw buffer directly to OP_NT (or direct/implicit convolution), and linear_forward_m likewise uses resident original weights. There is no per-call weight repacking operation for this idea to remove. Adding a transpose/cache would introduce preparation and generation state and is a different layout experiment, not the claimed cache removal. A real standalone byte-preserving generation cache helper remains parked and unintegrated; this is not a measured performance rejection.
experiments.source_entry: NeuralWeightGenerationCache.prepare(ctx,source,owner,generation,channels,taps); consumer reads buffer as KxOC with OP_NN
remaining_work: No public integration is warranted for the incumbent repack-removal premise

If a future packed-layout consumer is separately justified, it needs an owning mutation-generation contract, byte budget, context release and comparison against current no-repack OP_NT including cold preparation
Parked helper has no compile, identity, quality or timing qualification
quality_risks: Caller-supplied stale generation
Stream/context lifetime and asynchronous source reads
Packing can add cost when the original layout is already efficient

experiments.title: Convolution backward gather tiling
experiments.implemented_scope: Public convolution backward now selects bounded shared tap pages: 32 output pixels share cooperative reads of up to 64 source positions by eight adjacent taps, a 2-KiB page. Each output consumes kh/kw in exactly its incumbent order with unchanged FTZ and CP_REV. Row-crossing strips or dilation/stride footprints exceeding the page use the bounded-address reference spelling. Each gradient has one destination; the candidate coalesces loads rather than inventing repeated-value reuse.
